name: cajeerengine
product_changes: Admin UI 1.1.1 ships production static SPA assets in public/admin/assets, not preview fallback files.
Admin SPA includes Bearer login/logout, route guards and HTTP 401/403 handling.
Dashboard, content types, entries, media, CMS, users/RBAC, extensions, updates, search and import/export screens call real API endpoints.
admin:assets and publish-admin-assets validate production asset size/quality and write admin-manifest.json.
fix:admin-assets restores production admin assets from admin/static when public assets are missing.

notes.1.0.4: Install UX release: real web/CLI installer, SQLite quick start, install lock, first admin creation, secrets generation and dist-ready release plan.
notes.1.0.5: Server automation release: doctor/fix commands, Nginx generator, aaPanel preset, systemd templates, post-install report and backup alias.
notes.1.0.6: Release UX release: source/dist release split, checksums, GitFlic artifacts, upgrade wizard, one-command updater and backup before update.
notes.1.0.7: Admin UI hardening release: production static admin SPA, route guards, CMS CRUD workflows, protected web upgrade and release hygiene.
notes.1.1.1: Admin UI hardening release: production static admin SPA, real API CRUD screens, route guards, media upload, updates/search/import-export UI and strict admin asset verification.
notes.1.0.9: Import/export and updater hardening release: content/media import, dry-run diff, maintenance mode, rollback snapshots and post-update checks.
notes.1.1.0: Extension Runtime release: PHP providers, services, hooks/events, lifecycle install/uninstall, extension migrations and assets publishing.
